learnings: argparse subcommands, `type=` converters and mutually exclusive groups validate input before any logic runs.
Configuration layers (defaults < file < environment < flags) keep behaviour predictable.
Logs go to stderr and data to stdout, so the tool stays scriptable; exit codes tell scripts what happened.
pitfalls: Calling `sys.exit` deep inside the code makes it untestable – return an exit code from `run()` instead.
